name: 12b_dspark_bf16
description: 12B Gemma4 dense DSpark config, BF16 target (quantization disabled) — identical to 12b_dspark except no FP8. Draft = DSpark (deepseek-ai/dspark_gemma4_12b_block7 or local /tmp/models/gemma4_12b/dspark_speculator). spec_method=dspark, native block size 7 (spec_tokens=7). gpu_memory_utilization kept at 0.8 for the 262144-vocab draft headroom. Apples-to-apples vs 12b_e011_mtp_bf16 except draft+method+spec_tokens. Override the draft with GEMMA4_SPECULATOR_MODEL to point at a finetuned checkpoint.
